title: Shrug and Arrest

candidates.headline: 1. ホテル女性遺体、米海兵隊の男逮捕 強盗殺人容疑「知りません」―沖縄県 （時事） 2026/10/05
candidates.angle: A U.S. marine is arrested in Okinawa over a hotel murder yet answers with a blank 'I don't know'—a stark human contradiction that exposes tensions between U.S. forces and local authorities/governmental outrage.
candidates.title: Shrug and Arrest
candidates.scene: A hotel room doorway, crime-scene tape across it. Inside, a sheet-covered figure on the bed. In the foreground a uniformed U.S. marine sits handcuffed on a suitcase, shrugging exaggeratedly with a big speech bubble: “I DON’T KNOW.” To one side, an Okinawa police officer holds up an evidence bag; on the other, a small, furious Japanese official (labelled “Govt/PM”) waves a protest letter that says “EXTREMELY REGRETTABLE.” Behind them, a map of Okinawa with a tiny U.S. base icon and an angry local resident shaking a fist. Clear signage: hotel room number, police markers, and the marine’s uniform to identify him as U.S. forces.
candidates.reason: 米兵の逮捕と“知りません”の開き直りが強烈な視覚的逆説を生み、日米関係の摩擦も同時に示せるため即効性が高い。

candidates.headline: 2. 米、英基地からB-1爆撃機を全て撤収 テロ計画疑いで （WSJ） 2026/10/05
candidates.angle: U.S. strategic bombers are hurriedly pulled out of a British base over a terrorism plot suspicion—an absurd image of great instruments of power being treated like embarrassingly unwanted guests.
candidates.title: All Packed Up
candidates.scene: RAF Fairford airfield: two massive B-1 bombers being pushed onto giant rolling suitcases and into moving vans by puzzled ground crew. One bomber has a bright sticker reading “TERROR SUSPECT?” A harried U.S. officer holds an eviction notice stamped “URGENT,” while a bemused RAF airman sips tea and watches. In the background, a control tower with a sign: “Welcome — Now Leaving.” Emphasize scale by making the suitcases comically small next to the bombers, and include a map pinpointing the UK base for recognizability.
candidates.reason: 圧倒的な兵器が“荷造り”されて出て行くという馬鹿馬鹿しい対比が視覚的に即座に理解できる。

candidates.headline: 6. ソフトバンクGの孫氏､AIの安全性に異例の懸念表明－超知能は危険伴う （ブルームバーグ） 2026/10/05
candidates.angle: Masayoshi Son, a major AI investor, unusually warns about AI safety—the contradiction of a tech financier sounding the alarm on the very industry he bankrolls.
candidates.title: Investor's Alarm
candidates.scene: A stage or boardroom where a recognizable figure labelled “SoftBank Son” cradles a small glowing robot in his hands, face anxious. Behind him, towering shelves of investment folders and logos of AI startups smile like greedy toys. To one side, a giant coin-shaped mascot labelled “Venture $” looks confused. Speech bubble from Son: “It’s dangerous…?” Meanwhile, a robot in the background is sneakily unplugging a fire extinguisher labelled “REGULATION.” Clear props: SoftBank logo, stacks of pitch decks, and an uneasy contrast between money and maternal worry.
candidates.reason: 大金を注ぎ込む側が“危険”を訴えるという人間的逆説が分かりやすく、テクノロジーと資本の緊張を象徴できる。
